scope: Actual image-size nearest/bilinear/area resampling for every pixel layer and unstyled group, with masks/selections/native/AI; editable generated/adjustment/style/text sizing and full Photoshop/final AI coverage remain open.

core.note: Existing geometry regression run preceded the final resize-only edge and large no-op refinements; all nine size cases ran after these refinements.

verification.prior_full_baselines: Earlier full workspace/native/GPU baselines remain independent; this is targeted incremental verification.

native_manual.method: CUA live native AX and screenshot, no latency/quality benchmark claim.

semantics.sampling: Nearest preserves selected 8/16-bit codes and alpha-zero RGB. Bilinear uses premultiplied linear light with actual ICC. Area integrates rational pixel-box overlap for reducing axes and bilinear for other axes.
semantics.edges: Interior/off-artboard finite source edges sample transparent zero; linear axes retain conservative half-source-pixel support. Only edges exactly coinciding with the original artboard extend boundary samples, preserving opaque full-image borders. Independent interior alpha references and full-image corner checks pass.
semantics.geometry: i128 rational coordinates preserve nearest phase across tiles, negatives and approximately +/-1e12 offsets. Artboard top-left and DPI stay fixed; source outside new frame remains stored. Layer/group masks and current/previous selections resample with u16 coverage, then document selections rebind.
semantics.limits: 64M destination visits and 256M source taps across the command; eight cached/4096 decoded source blocks per raster, pooled output/scratch, cancellation during rows and long tap loops.
semantics.no_op: Equal dimensions preserve revision/history/dirty/current layer even on unsupported/locked types and sparse >64M canvases.
semantics.partial_types: Generated fills/adjustments/active styles/frozen style references explicitly reject before mutation; no implicit rasterization.

issues_resolved.native_type: Panel ratio helper now accepts the actual UInt32 frame fields; final native tests and Release pass.
issues_resolved.metal_reference: Odd image size plus even view magnification initially placed reference between pixel centers. Final test uses integer view center and odd magnification; all three modes agree with CPU.
issues_resolved.interior_edges: Added independent alpha coverage checks and corrected finite interior boundaries before final native/GPU/Release.

remaining: All incomplete P0-P3 features, generated/adjustment/style/text size models, additional professional resamplers, continuous performance, live model, device/platform and release gates remain open.
